debugData.name: Rain ripple atlas (shared, tileable)
debugData.description: 4 × 4 rain drops for a wet surface's rings: RG the direction away from the texel's drop (× 0.5 + 0.5), B 1 at the drop falling to 0 at the ring's largest radius, A the cell's time offset. Decoded by the toolkit's decodeRippleAtlas(). Linear data, UASTC without RDO. The toolkit's bakeRippleAtlas() with its defaults (256², 4 cells, seed 0), exported on WebGPU from the noiseLibrary scene's tab (exportBakedTexture, p304 D4-D5): the same texture without a bake at load.
